title: Quantum invariants of flat 2-bundles over 3-manifolds
summary: We construct a scalar invariant of flat principal 2-bundles over 3-manifolds, with structure 2-group $\mathcal{G}$, from an involutory Hopf algebra graded by $\mathcal{G}$. Expressing $\mathcal{G}$ in terms of a crossed module $χ$ and using the classification of such 2-bundles via the classifying space $Bχ$, this amounts to constructing a homotopy invariant of maps from 3-manifolds to $Bχ$.
